fields.cover_headline:
Out of content ideas?
Check what your
buyers {o:ask}.
fields.cover_sub: One buyer question. A week of posts.
fields.step1_body:
A buyer asked it in their words.
Use their words, not yours.
One question holds five posts.
Here's how to find yours.
fields.step2_body:
Check your support inbox.
Read a competitor's reviews.
Copy their exact words.
Then take it apart.
fields.step3_body:
Mon: answer. Tue: the mistake.
Wed: your story. Thu: the myth.
Fri: the steps.
Five posts. One draft away.
fields.step4_body:
Paste the question in Claude.
Ask for one post per angle.
Tell it: keep their wording.
Then add what only you know.
fields.step5_body:
A number from your product.
A moment you watched happen.
A mistake you made first.
Want all five prompts?
fields.cta_headline: I never know what to post.
fields.cta_subtext: Comment WEEK and I'll DM you the 5 Claude prompts that turn one buyer question into a week of posts.
